title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Numbers 13: the twelve men sent to spy out Canaan, the cluster of grapes from Eshcol, and the report they brought back.

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh tell Moses to send from every tribe to spy out the land of Canaan?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to send a man of every tribe of their fathers, every one a prince among them.

answers.text: A priest from the sons of Aaron
A young man who had never fought
A man of every tribe, each a prince among them

questions.text: Caleb the son of Jephunneh was sent from which tribe?
questions.explanation: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh was sent.

questions.text: What name did Moses give to Hoshea the son of Nun?
questions.explanation: Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

questions.text: What time of year was it when the spies were sent out?
questions.explanation: Moses told them to bring some of the fruit of the land; it was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

answers.text: The time of the barley harvest
The time of the first-ripe grapes
The time of the olive harvest

questions.text: In which place did the spies see Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the children of Anak?
questions.explanation: They went up by the South and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the children of Anak, were.

questions.text: How did the spies carry the cluster of grapes from the valley of Eshcol?
questions.explanation: They cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes and carried it on a staff between two men.

answers.text: On a cart pulled by oxen

questions.text: After how many days did the spies return from the land?
questions.explanation: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

questions.text: How did the spies describe the land when they came back?
questions.explanation: They said, "Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit."

answers.text: It is dry and full of stones
It flows with milk and honey
It has no water at all

questions.text: What did Caleb say when he stilled the people before Moses?
questions.explanation: Caleb said, "Let's go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!"

answers.text: "Let's go up at once, and possess it"
"Let's send more men to spy it out"

questions.text: How did the spies with the evil report say they looked in their own sight next to the Nephilim?
questions.explanation: They said, "We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight."
